_note: Shopping. price in £; minAge; needs = flag required; resale = fraction back if sold; weekly = running cost per week; once = one-off effects on purchase; perWeek = effects every week while owned; flags set on purchase (car removes the bus pass, home moves you out). news = front-page headline if bought.

items.name: Industrial tub of hair gel
items.blurb: Holds your hair in place through a hurricane. And a 4-0 defeat.

items.name: Eyebrow slits at Dazza's
items.blurb: Dazza did it with the clippers while talking about his divorce. It's slightly wonky.

items.name: Fresh trim at Dazza's
items.blurb: Dazza's been cutting hair since 1981. He's been doing the same cut since 1981.

items.name: Sliders and white socks
items.blurb: The official footwear of the warm-down and the court steps.

items.name: "Designer" tracksuit from the market
items.blurb: The logo's an alligator. Or a crocodile. Or a lizard with ambition.

items.name: Peroxide blond job
items.blurb: You look like a cotton bud. A confident cotton bud.

items.name: Designer tracksuit
items.blurb: Grey. Very grey. Expensive grey.

items.name: Your other half's name tattooed on your neck
items.blurb: Permanent. Unlike most of your relationships.

items.name: Enormous puffer coat
items.blurb: You can't put your arms down. Worth it.

items.name: Made-to-measure suit
items.blurb: Fitted so tight you can't sit down at the awards do. You stand all night, looking important.

items.name: Gucchini man bag
items.blurb: Holds a phone, a lip balm and absolutely nothing else.

items.name: Full sleeve tattoo
items.blurb: A lion, a clock, a rose, your nan's birthday and a Latin phrase that turns out to mean 'soup'.

items.name: Blinding porcelain veneers
items.blurb: Visible from space. Your dentist has bought a boat.

items.name: Wireless earbuds (one already lost)
items.blurb: The left one is somewhere on the team bus. It's been playing sea shanties for a week.

items.name: Ring light and tripod
items.blurb: For your 'content'. Your content is mostly you nodding at the camera.

items.name: Fitness tracker
items.blurb: It congratulates you on 40,000 steps. You know. You're a footballer.

items.name: Bigbeatz headphones in club colours
items.blurb: Worn round the neck through every airport. Never once on the ears.

items.name: Massage gun
items.blurb: Sounds like a pneumatic drill. Feels like one too.

items.name: Laptop for 'college work'
items.blurb: Used for coursework twice. Used to watch your own highlights 400 times.

items.name: New phone
items.blurb: Same as your old phone, but £800.

items.name: Camera drone
items.blurb: Filmed one lovely sunset and one very angry neighbour in a dressing gown.

items.name: Games console and a massive telly
items.blurb: Online with the lads every night. Rested, sort of.

items.name: Podcast studio set-up
items.blurb: Episode one: 'Banter'. Episode two never happened.

items.name: 24-carat gold phone
items.blurb: Weighs more than a brick. Still no signal at the training ground.

items.name: Home cryotherapy chamber
items.blurb: Three minutes at minus 110. The lads now call you Fish Finger.

items.name: Ten driving lessons
items.blurb: Your instructor, Barry, has a nervous twitch. You gave him it.

items.name: Second-hand moped
items.blurb: Top speed 31mph. Downhill. With a tailwind. Mum watches from the window, praying.

items.name: Second-hand Vauxhall Corsa
items.blurb: Three previous owners, one smell. Insurance for a teenager: eye-watering.

items.name: Fjord Fiestina with a body kit
items.blurb: The exhaust is wider than the engine. They can hear you in Belgium.

items.name: Vintage camper van
items.blurb: For surf trips you'll never take. Still, it's got a kettle.

items.name: Audeo A3 in matte black
items.blurb: Indicators sold separately. Not that you'd use them.

items.name: Range Rover with blacked-out windows
items.blurb: Every footballer has one. It's practically the law.

items.name: Mercator G-Wagon
items.blurb: Shaped like a fridge, priced like a house, handles like both.

items.name: Bentwood Continental
items.blurb: Mum says it's 'very nice' in the voice she uses for your tattoos.

items.name: Lamborghini (lime green)
items.blurb: Doesn't fit over the speed bumps at the training ground. Or Shopco.

items.name: Royce-Rollins Phantasm with starlight ceiling
items.news: STAR MAN: {NAME}'S £450K MOTOR HAS FAIRY LIGHTS IN THE ROOF
items.blurb: There are 1,340 tiny stars in the ceiling. You've named every one after yourself.

items.name: Bugatto Chiroptera hypercar
items.news: £2.8M HYPERCAR! {NAME} BUYS MOTOR FASTER THAN LAST TRANSFER
items.blurb: Top speed 261mph. Average speed on the ring road: 9mph.

items.name: Gold-plated chain from the market
items.blurb: Your neck's gone green. Iconic.

items.name: Casio calculator watch
items.blurb: Retro. Practical. You can spell BOOBS upside down.

items.name: Diamond(ish) stud earring
items.blurb: Cubic zirconia. Cubic confidence.

items.name: Club-crest cufflinks
items.blurb: For the awards do. And, eventually, the court date.

items.name: Chunky gold sovereign ring
items.blurb: Like your grandad's, except he worked forty years at the docks for his.

items.name: Rolex Submariner
items.news: TICK TOCK: {NAME} SPLASHES OUT ON £12K ROLEX
items.blurb: Waterproof to 300 metres, in case the training ground floods.

items.name: Diamond grillz
items.blurb: Mum cried. Not happy tears.

items.name: Iced-out pendant of your shirt number
items.blurb: It says 23. You've since been given the number 7.

items.name: Audemars Pigeon Royal Ock
items.news: TIME FOR A CHANGE: {NAME}'S £55K WRIST UPGRADE
items.blurb: Octagonal, like a stop sign. Nobody has ever stopped.

items.name: Diamond-encrusted watch
items.blurb: So shiny you can't read the time. It's always time to show off.

items.name: Diamond pinkie ring the size of a gobstopper
items.blurb: You can't get your hand in your pocket. You've stopped paying for things, which helps.

items.name: Patek Phillipson Grand Complication
items.blurb: It has a moon-phase dial. You've asked the kitman what that is three times.

items.name: Actual jewelled crown
items.blurb: You wear it to Sunday dinner. Gran has started curtseying out of fear.

items.name: Giant bean bag
items.blurb: It swallowed the TV remote and, briefly, the dog.

items.name: Air fryer
items.blurb: You've air-fried everything. Including, regrettably, a yoghurt.

items.name: Protein smoothie blender
items.blurb: Makes a green sludge that tastes of lawn. The physio is thrilled.

items.name: Robot hoover
items.blurb: Mum's stopped picking up your socks. So has the robot. It's scared of them.

items.name: Neon sign of your own name
items.blurb: Glows pink all night. The neighbours have started a petition.

items.name: Massage chair with 47 settings
items.blurb: You've only ever found setting one. It's fine. It's lovely.

items.name: Hot tub
items.blurb: Seats eight. Has held fourteen. The insurance man is concerned.

items.name: Home gym
items.blurb: Mirrors on every wall, so you can watch yourself do one bicep curl and stop.

items.name: Home cinema with leather recliners
items.blurb: Forty seats, surround sound, and every film you watch is your own goals.

items.name: Gold-plated toilet
items.blurb: Cold on the bum in winter. Worth it.

items.name: Floor-to-ceiling shark tank
items.blurb: Bruce the shark has a better contract than you, and a better agent.

items.name: Indoor infinity pool with your face on the bottom
items.blurb: Infinite in one direction: the direction of your bank balance.

items.name: Tin of posh biscuits for Gran
items.blurb: She'll save them 'for best'. They'll still be there in 2041.

items.name: Flowers for Mum
items.blurb: Petrol station carnations. She put them in her best vase anyway.

items.name: Doughnuts for the dressing room
items.blurb: The goalkeeper ate nine. Nobody was surprised.

items.name: Hamper for the gaffer
items.blurb: Brown-nosing, gift-wrapped. The lads saw you hand it over.

items.name: Fancy dinner for two
items.blurb: The portions were tiny. You had chips on the way home. Romantic.

items.name: Spa day for Mum
items.blurb: She's never been so relaxed. She rang you four times to tell you.

items.name: New kit for your old Sunday league team
items.blurb: The Dog & Duck Under-12s now look smarter than your current club.

items.name: Weekend in Paris for two
items.blurb: You spent the whole time posing by the tower. Your other half has posted none of the photos.

items.name: Stairlift for Gran
items.blurb: She rides it like a rollercoaster. Hands up and everything.

items.name: Designer handbag for your other half
items.blurb: Very small and very expensive. Like a lot of footballers.

items.name: Little car for Mum
items.blurb: She's put a nodding dog on the dashboard and a 'MY SON PLAYS FOOTBALL' sticker on the back.

items.name: Engraved watches for the whole squad
items.news: {NAME} SPLASHES £30K ON BLING FOR THE LADS
items.blurb: All 25 are engraved 'From The Gaffer'. You're not the gaffer. The gaffer is livid.

items.name: Buy Mum a house
items.news: DIAMOND GEEZER: {NAME} BUYS MUM A £450K HOUSE
items.blurb: Five bedrooms. She's kept one exactly like your old room, posters and all.

items.name: Goldfish from the fair
items.blurb: Named after the club captain. Similar attention span.

items.name: Hamster
items.blurb: Runs on his wheel all night. Fitter than your left-back.

items.name: Rescue cat
items.blurb: Ignores you completely, like the national team manager.

items.name: Python called Kevin
items.blurb: Your other half has moved into the spare room. Kevin has your side of the bed.

items.name: Pair of pygmy goats
items.blurb: They've eaten the hedge, the bins and a wing mirror.

items.name: Staffie called Tyson
items.blurb: Soft as butter. Terrifies the postman purely by looks.

items.name: Labrador puppy
items.blurb: Has eaten two boots, a shin pad and a contract offer.

items.name: Parrot that swears
items.blurb: Learned every word in the dressing room. Repeats them at Sunday dinner.

items.name: French bulldog in a tiny gilet
items.blurb: Can't breathe, can't walk far, has 40,000 followers.

items.name: Hawk to scare pigeons off the lawn
items.blurb: His name is Steve. He has caught nothing but the neighbour's toupee.

items.name: Two Dobermans in diamond collars
items.blurb: Trained to attack burglars. Currently scared of the robot hoover.

items.name: Koi carp pond
items.blurb: Each fish is worth more than your first contract. The big one is called Gaffer.

items.name: A proper football
items.blurb: For kicking against Mum's garage door, like old times. The dent is shaped like your career.

items.name: Fishing rod and a folding chair
items.blurb: You've never caught a fish. You've never wanted to.

items.name: Karaoke machine
items.blurb: Your power ballad has been reported to the council.

items.name: Massive garden trampoline
items.blurb: The physio has asked you, in writing, to stop.

items.name: Set of golf clubs
items.blurb: Every footballer plays golf. You mostly play in the trees.

items.name: Pool table
items.blurb: The centre-back hasn't potted a ball in two years. He's not much better at defending.

items.name: Jet ski
items.blurb: You live 90 miles from the sea. It lives on the drive.

items.name: Membership at a posh golf club
items.blurb: The committee voted you in 6-5. One member resigned. You count that as a win.

items.name: Racehorse called Back Of The Net
items.blurb: It's come last nine times. It's beautiful. You love it more than some relatives.

items.name: Your hometown non-league club
items.blurb: New floodlights, new roof on the stand, and Dazza's now the club barber.

items.name: Superyacht
items.news: ALL ABOARD! {NAME} SETS SAIL ON £8M SUPERYACHT
items.blurb: It has a helipad, a cinema and a crew of 22. You get seasick in the bath.

items.name: Private island
items.blurb: Twelve palm trees, one beach, no signal. Mum asks why you can't just go to Skegness.

items.name: Private jet
items.news: HIGH FLYER: {NAME} SPLASHES £18M ON PRIVATE JET
items.blurb: You use it for away games forty miles up the road. Climate campaigners have your face on a dartboard.

homes.name: Mum's back bedroom
homes.blurb: Single bed. Posters. Mum knocks. Mum never knocks.

homes.name: Flat share with Deano
homes.blurb: Deano's 'mate' sleeps on the sofa. Nobody knows his name.

homes.name: City-centre apartment
homes.blurb: Floor-to-ceiling windows, a balcony, and a concierge called Graham.

homes.name: Detached house in the suburbs
homes.blurb: Electric gates. The neighbours have opinions.

homes.name: Country pile with a moat
homes.news: MOAT-ER OF THE HOUSE: {NAME} BUYS £3.2M ESTATE
homes.blurb: Twelve bedrooms. One moat. Possibly a ghost.

rooms.name: Home gym
rooms.blurb: Slows the decline in your thirties. Currently mostly used to dry towels.

rooms.name: Recovery suite
rooms.blurb: Cryo chamber, hot tub, a massage chair that judges you.

rooms.name: Cinema room
rooms.blurb: Cheap date nights. Expensive popcorn machine.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.blurb: Better press answers. You've read one book. It was about fishing.

rooms.name: Home casino
rooms.blurb: Poker nights. Attracts the wild friends like moths to a roulette wheel.

rooms.name: Trophy room
rooms.blurb: Your framed newspapers move here from Mum's fridge. Press and visitors love it.
